data.name: Heptic Arena
data.detailed_description:
CLOSED PLAYTEST SIGNUPS


About the Game

THE GALAXY’S DEADLIEST GAME SHOW

In Heptic Arena, surviving isn’t enough - you have to steal the show. Battle as a squad through escalating phases where every choice matters: push objectives under fire, hunt high-value targets, or sabotage other teams while the arena intensifies and tries to take you down.

BATTLE IN CONTENDER HOMEWORLDS

The Arena is engineered as a stage, stitched together from worlds the contenders once called home. Players drop into four distinct biomes: the choking wetlands of Kortagan, the industrial steel-and-dust of Gomidesh, Yerosh’s desert wastes with caverns buried beneath, and the deceptively serene, Earth-like peaks of the Alps.

Each one is packed with its own environmental twists and feral PVE threats, ensuring that every step is either your next highlight reel or your last mistake.

SKILL WINS ROUNDS, STYLE WINS CROWDS

Every match in Heptic Arena is a live broadcast where chaos, competition, and spectacle collide. The gamemaster begins the show with map roulette, randomly dropping you into two of the four biomes.

Contestants then race to complete quests, outgun rivals, and rack up points to purchase and upgrade weapons that could help turn the match in their favor.

Completing quests helps you to zone in on the hidden Relic and unlock the Arena, where mayhem breaks out in a randomly selected showdown.

One might be a fierce fight over shifting objectives. Another, a tight close-quarters brawl for a single crucial position. But every finale is loud, lethal, and designed to deliver a spectacle the crowd won’t forget.

BECOME AN ARENA SUPERSTAR

The only thing between unknown and unforgettable is how you play the game. Even when the chips are down, there’s always a chance for a crazy comeback to wow the crowds and level up your infamy. So step forward, contestant - Make them watch!

AUDITION FOR OUR PLAYTESTS

If you want to be more than just another casualty in the archives, this is your VIP First Look at the frontlines, with closed playtests starting later this year.

Heptic Arena uses dedicated, geo-located servers to provide a smooth and consistent multiplayer experience.
